audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart and several prose fields claimed Sett wins Levels 1-3, while the content-layer whys, the packet levelChart and the 48.98% win rate all say Urgot owns the early lane.
audit.why: Urgot's Corrosive Charge (Q, 800 range) and Echoing Flames out-range every punch Sett has; Sett has no ranged tool and Facebreaker is only 490 range.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 are Urgot's; Level 6 is Sett's on The Show Stopper; 2+ items is a skill fight.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] told the player to all-in 'when his W is on cooldown'.
audit.why: Purge (W) is 12/9/6/3/0 seconds cooldown and 40/30/20/10/0 cost — at rank 5 it has no cooldown and no cost, so waiting for it to be down is waiting forever.
audit.corrected: Disdain (E) is the only real timer: 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, effectively a flat ~15s at every rank.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] and wants.* swapped Urgot's ability names (called Q 'Purge' and W 'Corrosive Charge'); spikes[3] invented a 'W wall' that does not exist in Urgot's kit.
audit.why: Riot's kit file: Q is Corrosive Charge, W is Purge (a self-slowing sustained-fire channel, not a wall). Also unstated: Facebreaker only STUNS when enemies are on opposite sides of Sett — pulling Urgot alone just slows him; and Haymaker's centre is true damage, so Urgot's armour does not reduce it.
audit.corrected: Names fixed; the 'W wall' claim removed; the Facebreaker positioning requirement and Haymaker true-damage centre are now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed Disdain twice with no numbers and described it as flipping 'the first champ behind him'.
audit.why: Riot's text: he charges, tramples non-champions, and stops on the first champion to hurl them out of his way; he is shielded during it.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with real cooldowns and the Purge-has-no-cooldown caveat.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing recorded the Facebreaker stun condition, which decides every Sett all-in here.
audit.why: Sett's E stuns only enemies on opposite sides of him; a lone target is slowed instead.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Urgot on every CS, but respect his opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Corrosive Charge (Q) and Echoing Flames out-range your punches at level 1, so you cannot auto-trade him. Farm the melee minions and hold your health bar.

edits.before: Q gives move speed toward Urgot and two empowered punches. Take short Q trades and back off before he can answer with Disdain (Flip).
edits.after: Knuckle Down (Q) gives move speed toward him, but Purge (W) shreds you the whole way in. Trade only when Corrosive Charge (Q) is down.

edits.before: Facebreaker is online — the E-stun into double punch + W is your full pattern. Run it the moment Urgot burns Disdain (Flip).
edits.after: Facebreaker (E, 490 range) matches Purge's 490 — but it only stuns with an enemy on your other side. Urgot still wins the DPS race.

edits.before: His W out-trades and pokes you — dodge his flip, all-in when W is down. Sett wins by trading around Urgot's Disdain (Flip) and cashing the pattern: dodge E and all-in on his W cooldown.
edits.after: Purge (W) out-trades you and Corrosive Charge (Q) pokes you out. Sett wins on one timer: Disdain (E) is a flat ~15s at every rank — bait it, then commit the E-stun and a full Grit Haymaker.

edits.before: Dodge E and all-in on his W cooldown. Track Disdain (Flip) before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Bait Disdain (E), then all-in inside its 14-16s window. Keep the wave on your side so he has to step into Facebreaker.

edits.before: - Urgot Disdain (Flip): matchup-defining — His engage. Bait it, then all-in. Track it before every engage. - Urgot Disdain: Charges, knocking enemies aside and flipping the first champ behind him. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Urgot Disdain (E): 16s at rank 1, 14s at rank 5 — his engage, his escape, and a shield. Bait it, then all-in. - Urgot Purge (W): free at rank 5, so it is never 'down' — beat it with range denial, not patience.

edits.before: Your double-punch passive wins the level-1 auto war almost on its own. Walk up with the wave and make Urgot pay for every last-hit, but bank small chips — don't coin-flip an all-in before E is up. Respect Urgot's Disdain (Flip) completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Urgot wins the level-1 to level-3 auto war outright: Corrosive Charge (Q) and Echoing Flames out-range every punch you have. Farm the melee wave, take the free ranged CS under tower, and wait for Facebreaker plus a full Grit bar — the first levels are about not dying, not about proving a point.

edits.before: Urgot owns this window: his Q Purge and W Corrosive Charge shred you while you build Grit, and his passive shotgun legs punish every step you take toward him — don't walk into range without a full bar and a plan.
edits.after: Urgot owns this window: Corrosive Charge (Q) slows and Purge (W) shreds while you build Grit, and Echoing Flames burns every step you take toward him — don't walk in without a full bar and Facebreaker up.

edits.before: Your R The Show Stopper is your one clean pick: wait out or dodge his R Fear Beyond Death, then flash-R him past his minions before he can execute you with the reactivation.
edits.after: The Show Stopper (R) hauls him away while he is helpless, so Disdain (E) cannot answer it: bait Fear Beyond Death, then slam him past his minions. At 120s rank 1, save it for kills.

edits.before: Urgot's Black Cleaver spike plus W uptime keeps him kiting you; you spike hard too on Trinity/Steraks, so all-in only when his W or E flip is on cooldown.
edits.after: Black Cleaver and maxed Purge (W) — free at rank 5, no cost, no cooldown — keep him kiting, so stop waiting on his W. Disdain (E) is the real timer: ~15s at every rank.

edits.before: Even-ish teamfights: your R suppress converts a target while his R execute + W wall zone the fight — whoever lands their ult first on the right target wins the exchange.
edits.after: Even-ish teamfights: The Show Stopper drags his frontliner out and lands him in your team, while Fear Beyond Death (2500 range, 70s late) executes anyone he chunks below the threshold.

edits.before: Levels 3-4 stay rough — Urgot's sustained W-Q pressure and range keep you behind. At 5 you finally spike: full E-W-Q burst with Grit shields lets you trade back, but he re-takes tempo at 6 when Fear Beyond Death threatens the execute.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 stay rough — Purge (W) and Corrosive Charge (Q) out-range you. Facebreaker (E) only stuns with enemies on both sides, so pull him across your minions; W's centre is true damage through his armour. At 6 his execute flips tempo.

edits.before: At 5 Sett's full combo plus Grit shielding finally lets him win the all-in trade.
edits.after: Level 6 The Show Stopper plus a full Grit shield wins Sett the all-in outright.

edits.after: Free Corrosive Charge (Q) slows to kite
